use: Compiles the library, the suites and the benchmarks in the profile catalog (debug, audit with -fanalyzer, sanitize, release, native, extreme, coverage).
prior_use: Every C repository of the platform and their releases (kyr_core, kyr_lmdb, kyr_drive, kyr_rms) since 2025.
output_checked_by: The suites in every profile and linkage, the ABI gate on the exported symbols, the hardening gate on the binaries, the second package build (same bytes), the warning analysis.
availability: Pinned by the build root's distribution snapshot; the root's identity is recorded with every run.

use: The C library the shared object needs (clock_gettime, getrandom, open, read, close); the only NEEDED entry.
prior_use: The platform's base on every target.
output_checked_by: The NEEDED analysis, the glibc-ceiling stage (no symbol newer than the root's), the installed-package smoke test.
availability: The distribution's, pinned by the root's snapshot; assessed as reused software in the SRF <4>.

use: Links and archives (ld, ar); nm, readelf and size for the binary analyses (on the workstation, version below).
output_checked_by: The hardening gate, the ABI export check, the smoke test against the extracted packages.

use: The framework of the integration and scenario suites.
output_checked_by: Every case asserts; a case missing from a log is reported as not run, never as passed; a framework fault fails the suite in every cell.
availability: Distribution package (deps.txt minimum 1.1.7), pinned by the root's snapshot.

use: Measures statement and decision coverage of the coverage run.
prior_use: The coverage stage of the platform's repositories.
output_checked_by: The uncovered lines it reports are the ones the inspections UUID7-IN-001, UUID7-IN-002 and the analysis UUID7-AN-012 cover (SVR <4.4>); a drop below the targets fails UUID7-AN-006.
availability: Distribution package, pinned by the root's snapshot.

use: The format gate (coding standard rule F1) with kyr-build's .clang-format.
prior_use: The format stage of every platform repository.
output_checked_by: The format stage refuses any difference; the configuration file is the pinned kyr-build's.
availability: The root's clang-format-18; the major is pinned (KYR_CLANG_FORMAT_MAJOR).

use: Profile catalog, wrappers, pipeline, ABI gate, hardening gate, packaging, buildinfo and the build root (build_root.sh).
prior_use: Every platform repository since kyr-build 2.0 and their releases.
output_checked_by: utils/deps.sh verifies the deb's SHA-256 against the pin; its gates are tested in kyr_build's own pipeline; a gate misused fails its stage.
availability: Own release on GitHub, pinned by SHA-256 in deps.txt and kept in the deb cache.

use: The pinned Ubuntu 24.04 snapshot in which the gates, the tests and the packages run (build_root.sh enter).
prior_use: Every platform release since the rev5 restart (2026-10-04).
output_checked_by: Its identity (suite, snapshot, tarball SHA-256, package list) is recomputed on entry; build_root.sh verify compares the files hash; each .buildinfo records it.
availability: Rebuilt from its pins on any machine; the tarball is cached.

use: Generates the documents, the matrices and the claim; computes the verdicts of the automated analyses from the evidence files; checks the rms export (drift, actors, baseline commits).
prior_use: ecss.py: none before this package (developed for it); python3: the platform's tooling.
output_checked_by: The matrices are compared with the rms export field by field (drift); a refused export ends RED; every verdict links its evidence file; the generated documents are read at each review.
availability: In the repository (ecss/tools), standard library only.

use: The site and the header pre-pass whose warnings verify the documented interface (UUID7-AN-010).
output_checked_by: Zero warnings required; the site is read at each review.
Visual check of the site at review.

use: Renders the sequence, class, package and component diagrams; without java the sources are embedded instead.
output_checked_by: The scenario tests assert every interaction they draw; the diagram is the record of a passing test, not its verdict.
availability: The MIT jar, pinned by file name; java from the distribution.

use: Holds the requirements, links, verification cases and results, reviews, RIDs, change requests and baselines; its package export is the source of truth of the TS, the traceability, the JRR and the verification matrix.
prior_use: The platform's own product; none as an ECSS source of truth before this package.
output_checked_by: The export is compared with the repository's CSVs and tags (drift), refused when a decision names no actor, its baselines checked for the commit they froze; its SHA-256 is printed with every refresh.
availability: Own release, pinned by SHA-256 where it is installed.

use: Identifies every file and version; tags mark releases.
output_checked_by: Content addressing; the SCF lists every file's SHA-256 at the evidence commit.
availability: Distribution package; the repository is mirrored on GitHub.
